query:
UPDATE students elite
INNER JOIN students regular ON regular.name = 'ANDREW'
SET 
  elite.birthDate = regular.birthDate,
  elite.beltLevel = regular.beltLevel,
  elite.phone = regular.phone
WHERE elite.name = '楊猷宸' AND elite.venue = '精英班道場';

UPDATE students 
SET name = '譚子銳' 
WHERE name = '譚子鋐' AND venue = '精英班道場';

UPDATE students elite
INNER JOIN students regular ON elite.name = regular.name
SET 
  elite.birthDate = regular.birthDate,
  elite.beltLevel = regular.beltLevel,
  elite.phone = regular.phone
WHERE elite.venue = '精英班道場'
AND regular.venue != '精英班道場'
AND elite.name IN ('林諾天', '林頴萳', '楊廷諄', '譚子銳');
